body.title: planMigration plans md label-line edits and companion notes
body.summary: For members whose epicSlug is rewritten, plan exact whole-line edits against the md's post-move path (the move's `to`, else its current mdPath), building each old line exactly as the renderer did from the stored meta: PLAN/LLD '**Epic:** `${String(oldSlug)}`' (the literal 'undefined' when no slug was stored) -> new; EXT '# Extend: <old> — <title>' and '> **Extends Epic `<old>`** — ...' -> new; DEF '# Epic: <epicShortName(old)>' and HLD '# HLD: <hldShortName(old)>' -> new, computed by calling the exported helpers on the parsed artifact with old vs new meta. No md edit for BUILD/CR/TESTS/SPEC/ISSUE. For relabelled members carrying body.companions, list each companion relPath in companionNotes (pages are not edited).
acceptanceChecks: PLAN/LLD get the '**Epic:**' edit at the post-move path, including a member whose old line reads '**Epic:** `undefined`'
EXT gets both title-line edits; DEF and HLD get the H1 edit, including a slug-less DEF whose old H1 is its first sentence
A relabelled HLD with a companion lists it in companionNotes and plans no edit to the page

tests.name: planMigration: PLAN/LLD get the '**Epic:**' md edit at the post-move path (including an old '`undefined`' line)
planMigration: BUILD/CR/TESTS get JSON-only rewrites; EXT gets its two title-line edits; DEF and HLD get their H1 edit (slug-less DEF first-sentence H1 -> slug H1)
planMigration: a relabelled HLD with a companion page plans no edit to the page and lists it in companionNotes
